description:
You are a patent paralegal at Summit IP Law Group. A raw text draft of a new medical device invention ('Adaptive Haptic Feedback Controller') has been received from the client, NeuroSync Interfaces. Your task is to format this text into a compliant US Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) patent specification using Apache OpenOffice Writer.

The raw text is located at '/home/ga/Documents/patent_draft.txt'.

Requirements:
1. Open Apache OpenOffice Writer and copy the text from the draft file.
2. Configure Page Setup: Set all margins (Top, Bottom, Left, Right) to exactly 1.00 inch.
3. Enable Line Numbering: Line numbers must appear in the left margin (Tools > Line Numbering).
4. Format Main Text: Use Times New Roman or Arial, 12pt font, and set Line Spacing to Double (2.0).
5. Format Section Headings: Headings (e.g., 'BACKGROUND OF THE INVENTION') must be Bold and All Caps.
6. Format Claims: The Claims section must use a specific numbered list format (1., 2., 3.).
7. Format Abstract: Ensure the Abstract starts on a new page (insert a page break before the Abstract heading).
8. Save the final document as '/home/ga/Documents/NeuroSync_Patent_App.odt' in ODF Text Document format.

metadata.invention_title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR ADAPTIVE HAPTIC FEEDBACK IN VIRTUAL ENVIRONMENTS
